svg.title: Analog macro floorplan
svg.text: Analog_top as a hard macro: floorplan to scale
229.1 x 127.1 um = 29,119 um² · west edge faces the analog pads, south edge the digital top, north edge the AVDD pair
Block areas from the Analog_top netlist; MIMs (cap_mim_2f0_m4m5) drawn over their circuits. Scale 4.2 px/um.
MOS caps on AVDD + substrate taps
(DVDD/DVSS rails for the latch row enter here)
10 um straps from bidir[45] / bidir[44]; Metal4/5 PDN keep-out over the whole macro (MIMs use M4/M5)
· vin enters on the pad side, one short bus to 4 x S0
· vramp, vref (= vbl) in the bus channel, each beside AVSS
· bot[i] (floating plate) under its own MIM;
· latch row (DVDD) at the south edge:
dout -> latch is one short hop
· bias lines drop from bias_gen in the
· vrlo_ref beside the ramp it feeds
· test zone on the pad side; replica cell
at the west end of the cell row
